rawContent: The #MeToo movement will need to include men's stories of being raped by other men or by women. There is no distinction between the genders in the pain, humiliation, and disgust felt by anyone who is the target/victim of an attempted or completed sexual assault. Open the doors.

For those media outlets who concentrate only on female targets/victims in the #MeToo movement are doing a grave injustice to the male targets/victims who are being ignored. Do your jobs properly and report on both genders in order to help everyone. Open the doors to the movement.
